changelog:
Initial release of the Foreseek skill for trading prediction markets via natural language.

- Trade, manage, and view Kalshi prediction markets using simple commands.
- Parse natural language predictions and match them to relevant markets.
- Execute market and limit orders, view open positions, and manage orders (view/cancel).
- Search for markets, view account status, balance, and portfolio.
- Supports watchlists and detailed operation reference for all endpoints.
- Requires a FORESEEK_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
summary: Trade prediction markets with natural language via Foreseek. Matches your beliefs to Kalshi contracts and executes trades. Use when user wants to bet on or trade predictions about elections, politics, sports outcomes, economic data (Fed rates, CPI, GDP), crypto prices, weather events, or any real-world event outcomes. Supports viewing positions, parsing predictions, executing market/limit orders, managing orders, and checking account status.
